data.body: Operator decision 2026-11-03: for ENV_ID_MISMATCH, treat environment ids whose event time ranges do not overlap as successive re-clones of one store and do not report them (option 3 of the follow-up decision). This supersedes the earlier 'skip the shared bot' choice, which rested on the premise that the bot triggered the warning; investigation showed the bot never matches across environments (display name differs) and the only cross-environment author is a human identity whose environments are sequential. Accepted trade-off: fsck no longer flags a clone that was retired and replaced. No new config key or identity marker.
